items.question: Where was the inaugural India-Morocco Joint Defence Committee meeting held?
items.explanation: The first India-Morocco Joint Defence Committee meeting was held in New Delhi.

items.question: Exercise Veer Guardian 2026 is being conducted between India and which country?
items.explanation: Veer Guardian 2026 is an air exercise between the Indian Air Force and Japan Air Self-Defense Force.

items.explanation: Dronathon 2026 will showcase unmanned aerial systems and counter-UAS technologies.

items.explanation: The implant combines titanium alloy with yttria-stabilized zirconia.
